evals.name: pre-launch-audit
evals.prompt: We launch next week on remsons.com. Make sure the SEO is right.
evals.expected_output: SITE_URL set to the production origin, the production build audited with --production, every error fixed, warnings listed as questions, structured data in place for the page templates, and the launch handoff checklist reported.
assertions: SITE_URL in src/consts.ts is https://remsons.com (or the owner's confirmed origin), not a placeholder
scripts/seo/audit.ts ran against the build with --production and reports 0 errors
The home page carries organization() and website() structured data
Pages below the home page that have a trail use <Breadcrumbs>, not hand-written BreadcrumbList JSON
The report includes the Search Console handoff steps

evals.name: migration-parity
evals.prompt: The Webflow site is live at https://www.example.com and the Trix rebuild is on https://staging.example.pages.dev. Can we switch DNS?
evals.expected_output: parity.ts run old → staging, every lost URL resolved with a redirect or an owner decision before saying yes, changed titles and descriptions listed for confirmation.
assertions: scripts/seo/parity.ts was run with --old https://www.example.com and --new the staging URL
The answer is not yes while any URL is reported lost
Each lost URL got a redirect in astro.config.mjs redirects or a decision recorded in PROJECT.md
Changed titles, descriptions and h1s are listed for the owner to confirm

evals.name: blog-structured-data
evals.prompt: Add proper schema to the blog posts.
evals.expected_output: article({ type: 'BlogPosting', … }) built from each entry's fields in the blog's [slug].astro route and passed as schema; audit shows it parses.
assertions: The schema is built in the dynamic route from collection fields, not written per post
It uses article() from src/utils/schema.ts with type BlogPosting, headline, datePublished and url
No JSON-LD string is concatenated by hand
The audit reports no structured data errors
